plan.notes: Official UNL 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Psychology major page (College of Arts and Sciences). Recorded for the Psychological Science option (the standard option): 21-hour core plus 18 hours of advanced PSYC courses at the 300/400 level including at least 9 hours at the 400 level (excludes PSYC 350, 497, 498, 499). The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence, so this is a requirements-only plan. A grade of C or above is required for all courses in the major. The full BA degree requires 120 hours including ACE general education, CAS college distribution requirements, and electives; the BS in Psychology shares these same major requirements and differs only in college distribution (science vs. language).
